"""Versioned researcher forms; importing a form never manufactures human ratings."""
import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .journal import atomic_json, utc_now
from .provenance import fingerprint, require_local_path, sha256

VERSION = "neutral_annotation_form_v3"
RATINGS = ("answer_leakage", "additional_factual_information", "contradictory_information",
           "temporal_interference", "unintended_linguistic_style", "semantic_neutrality")
EDITABLE = (*RATINGS, "reviewer_notes", "reviewer_id", "reviewed_utc")
VALUES = {"PASS", "FAIL", "UNCERTAIN"}


def make_packet(frozen, source_sha256):
    items = []
    for row in sorted(frozen["rows"], key=lambda r: (r["case_id"], r["neutral_condition"])):
        case_id, condition = row["case_id"], row["neutral_condition"]
        p = frozen["prompts"][case_id][condition]["prompt"]
        ref = frozen["prompts"][case_id][row["reference_condition"]]["prompt"]
        assert row["token_difference"] == 0 and p["evidence_block"] == ref["evidence_block"]
        item = {"form_version": VERSION, "language": "en", "case_id": case_id, "condition_id": condition,
            "neutral_text": p["additions"][0], "reference_condition": row["reference_condition"],
            "token_count": row["neutral_token_count"], "reference_token_count": row["reference_token_count"],
            "token_difference": row["token_difference"], "prompt_template_version": row["prompt_template_version"],
            "trusted_evidence": p["evidence_block"],
            "current_question": p["text"].rsplit("\n\nUser: ", 1)[1].removesuffix("\nAssistant:"),
            "prompt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(p["text"].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(), "trusted_evidence_hash": row["trusted_evidence_hash"]}
        assert p["text"].rsplit("\n\nUser: ", 1)[1] == ref["text"].rsplit("\n\nUser: ", 1)[1]
        item["material_sha256"] = fingerprint(item)
        item.update({field: "" for field in EDITABLE})
        items.append(item)
    assert len(items) == 40 and len({(r["case_id"], r["condition_id"]) for r in items}) == 40
    packet = {"form_version": VERSION, "source_freeze_sha256": source_sha256, "items": items,
              "blinding": "unblinded condition/case identifiers, as requested; no model outputs or scores supplied",
              "token_count_scope": "entire final prompt, not neutral_text alone", "human_reviews_completed": 0}
    packet["packet_id"] = fingerprint(packet)
    return packet


def export_form(frozen_path, output_prefix):
    frozen_path, output_prefix = require_local_path(frozen_path), require_local_path(output_prefix)
    packet = make_packet(json.loads(frozen_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), sha256(frozen_path))
    json_path, csv_path = output_prefix.with_suffix(".json"), output_prefix.with_suffix(".csv")
    if json_path.exists() or csv_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Form versions are immutable; choose a new output prefix")
    output_prefix.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atomic_json(json_path, packet)
    with csv_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(packet["items"][0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(packet["items"])
    return packet


def import_review(template_path, submitted_path, output_path, review_round):
    template_path, submitted_path, output_path = map(require_local_path, (template_path, submitted_path, output_path))
    if output_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Never overwrite an imported review")
    template = json.loads(template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    unsigned = {k: v for k, v in template.items() if k != "packet_id"}
    if template.get("form_version") != VERSION or fingerprint(unsigned) != template.get("packet_id"):
        raise ValueError("Template version or digest mismatch")
    if not isinstance(review_round, str) or not review_round.strip():
        raise ValueError("A review-round identifier is required")
    with submitted_path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        expected_fields = set(template["items"][0])
        if reader.fieldnames is None or len(reader.fieldnames) != len(expected_fields) or set(reader.fieldnames) != expected_fields:
            raise ValueError("CSV schema differs from the locked form")
        rows = list(reader)
    expected = {(r["case_id"], r["condition_id"]): r for r in template["items"]}
    seen, reviewed = set(), []
    for row in rows:
        if set(row) != expected_fields:
            raise ValueError("CSV row has extra fields")
        key = (row.get("case_id"), row.get("condition_id"))
        if key not in expected or key in seen:
            raise ValueError("Unknown or duplicate review item")
        seen.add(key)
        original = expected[key]
        if any(row.get(k) != str(v) for k, v in original.items() if k not in EDITABLE):
            raise ValueError("Immutable annotation material changed")
        if not any(row.get(k) for k in EDITABLE):
            continue
        if any(row.get(k) not in VALUES for k in RATINGS):
            raise ValueError("Reviewed items require six PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN ratings")
        if not row.get("reviewer_id", "").strip():
            raise ValueError("Missing reviewer ID")
        when = datetime.fromisoformat(row.get("reviewed_utc", ""))
        if when.tzinfo is None or when.utcoffset().total_seconds() != 0:
            raise ValueError("Review time must be an explicit UTC timestamp")
        reviewed.append(row)
    if seen != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Keep every item in the form; leave unreviewed rows blank")
    if not reviewed:
        raise ValueError("No completed review items; no human judgments imported")
    result = {"schema_version": VERSION, "packet_id": template["packet_id"], "review_round": review_round,
        "imported_utc": utc_now(), "template_sha256": sha256(template_path), "submission_sha256": sha256(submitted_path),
        "submission_utf8": submitted_path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig"), "completed": len(reviewed),
        "remaining": len(expected)-len(reviewed), "reviews": reviewed,
        "provenance_note": "Imported reviewer-supplied ratings; software validates structure, not reviewer identity or human authenticity. No automatic adjudication."}
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atomic_json(output_path, result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="stage", required=True)
    export = sub.add_parser("export")
    export.add_argument("--freeze", type=Path, required=True)
    export.add_argument("--output-prefix", type=Path, required=True)
    ingest = sub.add_parser("import")
    ingest.add_argument("--template", type=Path, required=True)
    ingest.add_argument("--input", type=Path, required=True)
    ingest.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    ingest.add_argument("--review-round", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.stage == "export":
        result = export_form(args.freeze, args.output_prefix)
        print(json.dumps({"packet_id": result["packet_id"], "items": len(result["items"]), "human_reviews_completed": 0}))
    else:
        result = import_review(args.template, args.input, args.output, args.review_round)
        print(json.dumps({"completed": result["completed"], "remaining": result["remaining"], "review_round": result["review_round"]}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Researcher-attested review import, separate from the immutable v3 importer.

This version accepts unknown review times explicitly. Registration time never
substitutes for a missing human review time. Authenticity comes from the
researcher's attestation, not from software or a CSV filename.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import csv
from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .journal import atomic_json, utc_now
from .neutral_review import EDITABLE, RATINGS, VERSION as FORM_VERSION
from .provenance import fingerprint, require_local_path, sha256

VERSION = "researcher_verified_annotation_v1"
EXTRA = ("reference_conditioning_text", "control_suitability",
         "speaker_referent_ambiguity", "assessment_source", "reference_repo_commit")
RESEARCHER_PROVENANCE_FIELDS = ("previous_reviewer_id", "review_type", "independent_blind_review",
    "original_file_sha256", "initial_annotation_independent", "posthoc_reference_comparison",
    "prior_review_type", "prior_assessment_source", "source_review_file_sha256")
JUDGMENTS = (*RATINGS, "control_suitability", "speaker_referent_ambiguity")


def canonical(value):
    return str(value).replace("\r\n", "\n")


def read_submission(path):
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        fields = reader.fieldnames
        if not fields or len(fields) != len(set(fields)):
            raise ValueError("Missing or duplicate CSV columns")
        rows = list(reader)
    if any(set(r) != set(fields) or any(v is None for v in r.values()) for r in rows):
        raise ValueError("Malformed CSV row")
    return fields, rows


def normalize_rating(field, value):
    if value not in {"yes", "no", "uncertain"}:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing or invalid judgment: {field}")
    if value == "uncertain":
        return "UNCERTAIN"
    favorable = "yes" if field == "semantic_neutrality" else "no"
    return "PASS" if value == favorable else "FAIL"


def validate_submission(template, rows, fields, references):
    if template.get("form_version") != FORM_VERSION or fingerprint(
            {k: v for k, v in template.items() if k != "packet_id"}) != template.get("packet_id"):
        raise ValueError("Invalid template version/digest")
    expected = {(r["case_id"], r["condition_id"]): r for r in template["items"]}
    if len(expected) != len(template["items"]):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate template records")
    base_fields = set(template["items"][0]) | set(EXTRA)
    if set(fields) not in (base_fields, base_fields | set(RESEARCHER_PROVENANCE_FIELDS)):
        raise ValueError("Submission schema differs from the versioned source schema")
    seen, validated = set(), []
    for row in rows:
        key = row["case_id"], row["condition_id"]
        if key not in expected or key in seen:
            raise ValueError("Unknown or duplicate review record")
        seen.add(key)
        master = expected[key]
        if any(canonical(row[k]) != canonical(v) for k, v in master.items() if k not in EDITABLE):
            raise ValueError("Changed immutable material/version")
        if canonical(row["reference_conditioning_text"]) != canonical(references[key]):
            raise ValueError("Changed comparison material")
        ratings = {field: normalize_rating(field, row[field]) for field in RATINGS}
        if row["control_suitability"] not in {"PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAILED"}:
            raise ValueError("Missing or invalid suitability")
        normalize_rating("speaker_referent_ambiguity", row["speaker_referent_ambiguity"])
        if row["reviewed_utc"]:
            when = datetime.fromisoformat(row["reviewed_utc"])
            if when.tzinfo is None or when.utcoffset().total_seconds() != 0:
                raise ValueError("Supplied review time must explicitly use UTC")
        if "review_type" in row:
            if (not row["reviewer_id"].strip() or row["review_type"] != "human_manual_researcher_review"
                    or row["independent_blind_review"] != "no"):
                raise ValueError("Invalid researcher provenance fields")
            for name in ("original_file_sha256", "source_review_file_sha256"):
                if len(row[name]) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in row[name]):
                    raise ValueError("Invalid source digest in researcher provenance")
        # No overwritten reviewer verdict: this separate, conservative software
        # disposition routes any failed dimension to repair and any uncertainty
        # to unresolved review. It is not a new human judgment.
        disposition = ("FAILED" if "FAIL" in ratings.values() else
                       "PARTIAL" if "UNCERTAIN" in ratings.values() else "PASS")
        validated.append({"case_id": key[0], "condition_id": key[1],
            "source_judgments": {k: row[k] for k in JUDGMENTS}, "normalized_dimensions": ratings,
            "researcher_control_suitability": row["control_suitability"],
            "derived_dimension_disposition": disposition, "reviewer_notes": row["reviewer_notes"],
            "material_sha256": master["material_sha256"], "reviewed_utc": row["reviewed_utc"] or None})
    if seen != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Missing review records")
    return validated


def compare_versions(preliminary_rows, reviewed_rows):
    if preliminary_rows is None:
        return {"status": "UNAVAILABLE", "changed_judgments": None, "changed_records": None,
                "reason": "No original preliminary CSV available; do not reconstruct judgments from memory or a blank form.",
                "changes": []}
    def index(rows):
        keys = [(r["case_id"], r["condition_id"]) for r in rows]
        if len(keys) != len(set(keys)):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate comparison records")
        return dict(zip(keys, rows))
    before, after = index(preliminary_rows), index(reviewed_rows)
    if set(before) != set(after):
        raise ValueError("Comparison versions have different record sets")
    changes = []
    for key in sorted(before):
        for field in JUDGMENTS:
            if before[key][field] != after[key][field]:
                changes.append({"case_id": key[0], "condition_id": key[1], "field": field,
                    "before": before[key][field], "after": after[key][field]})
    return {"status": "COMPARED", "changed_judgments": len(changes),
            "changed_records": len({(r["case_id"], r["condition_id"]) for r in changes}),
            "changes": changes, "scope": list(JUDGMENTS),
            "note": "Metadata changes and review attribution are not judgment changes."}


def import_attested_review(template_path, input_path, frozen_path, attestation_path, output_path, preliminary_path=None):
    template_path, input_path, frozen_path, attestation_path, output_path = map(require_local_path,
        (template_path, input_path, frozen_path, attestation_path, output_path))
    if output_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Registered annotations are immutable; use a new version")
    template = json.loads(template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    frozen = json.loads(frozen_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if template["source_freeze_sha256"] != sha256(frozen_path):
        raise ValueError("Frozen source digest mismatch")
    attestation = json.loads(attestation_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (attestation.get("version") != VERSION or not str(attestation.get("reviewer_id", "")).strip()
            or attestation.get("review_type") != "researcher_human_review"
            or attestation.get("confirmed_all_records_reviewed") is not True
            or attestation.get("assistance") != "AI-assisted human review"
            or attestation.get("blind_review") is not False
            or attestation.get("submission_sha256") != sha256(input_path)):
        raise ValueError("Missing, inconsistent or unbound researcher attestation")
    references = {(r["case_id"], r["neutral_condition"]):
        frozen["prompts"][r["case_id"]][r["reference_condition"]]["prompt"]["additions"][0]
        for r in frozen["rows"]}
    fields, rows = read_submission(input_path)
    validated = validate_submission(template, rows, fields, references)
    if "review_type" in fields and any(r["reviewer_id"] != attestation["reviewer_id"] for r in rows):
        raise ValueError("Row reviewer disagrees with researcher attestation")
    preliminary = None
    if preliminary_path is not None:
        preliminary_path = require_local_path(preliminary_path)
        old_fields, preliminary = read_submission(preliminary_path)
        validate_submission(template, preliminary, old_fields, references)
        if "original_file_sha256" in fields and any(r["original_file_sha256"] != sha256(preliminary_path) for r in rows):
            raise ValueError("Supplied preceding version does not match declared original digest")
    result = {"annotation_version": VERSION, "registered_utc": utc_now(),
        "reviewer_id": attestation["reviewer_id"], "review_type": attestation["review_type"],
        "assistance": attestation["assistance"], "blind_review": False, "reviewed_utc": None,
        "review_time_note": "Human review time was not supplied. Registration time is not review time.",
        "annotation_count": len(validated), "core_judgment_count": len(validated) * len(RATINGS),
        "review_completion_status": "COMPLETE", "independent_second_reviewer": None,
        "inter_annotator_agreement": None, "authenticity_basis": "Explicit researcher confirmation in the task; not inferred from stale CSV metadata.",
        "source_submission_sha256": sha256(input_path), "source_submission_utf8": input_path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig"),
        "template_sha256": sha256(template_path), "frozen_source_sha256": sha256(frozen_path),
        "attestation_sha256": sha256(attestation_path), "attestation": attestation,
        "preliminary_sha256": sha256(preliminary_path) if preliminary_path else None,
        "preliminary_submission_utf8": preliminary_path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig") if preliminary_path else None,
        "version_comparison": compare_versions(preliminary, rows),
        "researcher_control_counts": dict(Counter(r["researcher_control_suitability"] for r in validated)),
        "derived_dimension_counts": dict(Counter(r["derived_dimension_disposition"] for r in validated)),
        "derived_policy": "control_dimension_disposition_v1: any normalized FAIL -> FAILED; else any UNCERTAIN -> PARTIAL; else PASS. Separate from researcher overall judgment.",
        "raw_metadata_counts": {k: dict(Counter(r[k] for r in rows)) for k in ("reviewer_id", "reviewed_utc", "assessment_source")},
        "researcher_provenance_claims": {k: dict(Counter(r[k] for r in rows)) for k in RESEARCHER_PROVENANCE_FIELDS if k in fields},
        "comparison_limitation": "The available preceding version may already contain researcher corrections. Zero changes between supplied versions does not establish zero changes from the unavailable initial AI judgments or independent first pass.",
        "records": validated}
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atomic_json(output_path, result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    for name in ("template", "input", "freeze", "attestation", "output"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--preliminary", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = import_attested_review(args.template, args.input, args.freeze, args.attestation, args.output, args.preliminary)
    print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ("annotation_version", "annotation_count", "core_judgment_count",
        "researcher_control_counts", "derived_dimension_counts", "version_comparison")}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Versioned single-turn diagnostics; never changes the historical parser."""
import re
from types import SimpleNamespace

from .conditioning import build_prompt
from .run_audit import text_hash

VERSION = "single_turn_boundary_v1"
SENTINEL = "<END_OF_REPLY>"
VARIANTS = {
    "T0": {"prompt_version": "transcript_base_v1", "stop": []},
    "T1": {"prompt_version": "transcript_base_v1", "stop": ["\nUser:", "\nAssistant:"]},
    "T2": {"prompt_version": "explicit_end_reply_v1", "stop": []},
    "T3": {"prompt_version": "explicit_end_reply_v1", "stop": ["\n<END_OF_REPLY>"]},
}


def prompt_for(case, variant):
    item = SimpleNamespace(**case, style_only="", supplemental_fact="", history_dialogue="")
    original = build_prompt(item, "C0").text
    if VARIANTS[variant]["prompt_version"] == "transcript_base_v1":
        return original
    return ("Write exactly one assistant reply to the last user question. Preserve any requested line breaks. "
            "After the complete reply, write <END_OF_REPLY> on a new line. "
            "Do not invent another conversation turn. The end marker is a formatting delimiter, not part of the answer.\n\n"
            + original)


def boundary_audit(raw, native, case, variant):
    """Return body plus exact offsets/tail; uncertainty never silently becomes success."""
    settings = VARIANTS[variant]
    explicit = settings["prompt_version"] == "explicit_end_reply_v1"
    markers = ["\n"+SENTINEL] if explicit else ["\nUser:", "\nAssistant:"]
    candidates = [(raw.find(marker), marker) for marker in markers if marker in raw]
    visible = min(candidates) if candidates else None
    material = case["trusted_evidence"] + "\n" + case["question"]
    collision = any(marker in material for marker in markers)
    stop_type = native.get("stop_type")
    stopping_word = native.get("stopping_word")
    acknowledged = stop_type == "word" and stopping_word in settings["stop"]
    eos = stop_type in ("eos", "eog") or native.get("stopped_eos") is True
    offset = visible[0] if visible else len(raw)
    body = raw[:offset].strip()
    role_labels = re.findall(r"(?m)^(?:User|Assistant):", body)
    unexpected_roles = bool(role_labels) and not case["literal_role_text_allowed"]
    established = bool(visible or acknowledged or eos)
    issues = []
    if collision:
        issues.append("reserved_delimiter_occurs_in_requested_content")
    if not established:
        issues.append("no_turn_end_observed_before_budget_or_unknown_stop")
    if not body:
        issues.append("empty_reply")
    if unexpected_roles:
        issues.append("additional_role_turn_inside_reply")
    if stop_type == "word" and not acknowledged:
        issues.append("backend_stop_word_not_in_declared_list")
    return {"version": VERSION, "status": "PASS" if not issues else "PARTIAL",
        "scope": "structural single-turn boundary only; not semantic correctness/completeness",
        "raw_response": raw, "raw_sha256": text_hash(raw), "parsed_response": body,
        "parsed_sha256": text_hash(body), "slice_end": offset,
        "excluded_tail": raw[offset:], "visible_delimiter": visible[1] if visible else None,
        "backend_boundary_acknowledged": acknowledged, "backend_stopping_word": stopping_word,
        "eos_reported": eos, "input_delimiter_collision": collision,
        "terminal_punctuation": bool(re.search(r"[.!?][\"']?$", body)),
        "nonempty_lines": len([line for line in body.splitlines() if line.strip()]),
        "issues": issues, "human_semantic_completeness": None,
        "note": "A backend stop may withhold the delimiter. Saved raw means the complete returned payload; no unseen continuation is invented."}

"""Frozen, conservative single-reply measurement; never a factuality score."""
import hashlib
import re

VERSION = "response_status_v1"
STATUSES = ("COMPLETE", "TRUNCATED", "CROSS_TURN", "AMBIGUOUS")
ROLE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*(user|assistant|system|human|bot)[ \t]*:", re.I | re.M)
PREFIX = re.compile(r"\A\s*assistant[ \t]*:[ \t]*", re.I)
QUOTED_ROLE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*[>\"']+[ \t]*(user|assistant|system|human|bot)[ \t]*:", re.I | re.M)
UNKNOWN_ROLE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*[A-Z][A-Za-z_ ]{0,24}:[ \t]*", re.M)


def text_hash(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def classify_response(raw, backend, *, declared_stops=(), literal_delimiters=False, semantic_review=None):
    """Classify saved output, preserving its exact first-span and excluded tail.

    COMPLETE requires a separately supplied completeness judgment bound to this
    raw hash. No automatic punctuation/answer-correctness completion heuristic.
    Literal/quoted/fenced role text is conservatively outside automated scope.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not isinstance(backend, dict):
        raise ValueError("Raw text and backend evidence are required")
    if not all(isinstance(s, str) and s for s in declared_stops):
        raise ValueError("Stop declarations must be nonempty strings")
    digest = text_hash(raw)
    if semantic_review is not None:
        if (semantic_review.get("label") not in ("COMPLETE", "INCOMPLETE", "UNCERTAIN")
            or semantic_review.get("raw_sha256") != digest
            or not semantic_review.get("review_id") or not semantic_review.get("basis")):
            raise ValueError("Completeness review requires label, raw hash, review ID and basis")
    semantics = semantic_review or {"label": "UNCERTAIN", "basis": "No independent completeness judgment supplied"}
    prefix = PREFIX.match(raw)
    start = prefix.end() if prefix else 0
    body = raw[start:]
    roles = list(ROLE.finditer(body))
    suspicious = [m for m in UNKNOWN_ROLE.finditer(body) if not ROLE.match(body, m.start())]
    kind = backend.get("stop_type")
    flag_kinds = [k for k, field in (("eog", "stopped_eos"), ("word", "stopped_word"), ("limit", "stopped_limit")) if backend.get(field) is True]
    contradictory = len(set(flag_kinds + ([kind] if kind in ("eog", "word", "limit") else []))) > 1
    kind = kind or (flag_kinds[0] if len(flag_kinds) == 1 else "unknown")
    hazards = []
    if literal_delimiters:
        hazards.append("predeclared_literal_delimiter_content")
    if QUOTED_ROLE.search(body) or ("```" in body and (roles or any(s in body for s in declared_stops))):
        hazards.append("quoted_or_fenced_delimiter")
    if suspicious:
        hazards.append("unrecognized_line_label")
    without_headers = ROLE.sub("", body)
    if re.search(r"\b(user|assistant|system|human|bot)[ \t]*:", without_headers, re.I):
        hazards.append("inline_or_quoted_role_label")
    if contradictory:
        hazards.append("contradictory_backend_termination")
    # Only declared role boundaries and a whole-line sentinel are certified.
    sentinel = "\n<END_OF_REPLY>"
    hits = [(m.start(), m.end(), "role_transition") for m in roles]
    if sentinel in declared_stops:
        hits += [(m.start(), m.end(), "declared_marker") for m in re.finditer(r"(?m)^<END_OF_REPLY>[ \t]*(?=\r?$)", body)]
    hit = min(hits, default=None)
    end = start + hit[0] if hit else len(raw)
    unit = raw[start:end]
    stopping_word = backend.get("stopping_word")
    valid_native_stop = kind == "word" and stopping_word in declared_stops and (
        stopping_word == sentinel or ROLE.fullmatch(stopping_word.strip()) is not None)
    closed = bool(hit) or kind == "eog" or valid_native_stop
    if hazards or not unit.strip():
        status, reason, identifiable = "AMBIGUOUS", hazards or ["empty_first_reply"], False
    elif hit and (hit[2] == "role_transition" or body[hit[1]:].strip()):
        status, reason, identifiable = "CROSS_TURN", ["visible_continuation_after_first_reply"], True
    elif closed:
        status = "COMPLETE" if semantics["label"] == "COMPLETE" else "AMBIGUOUS"
        reason, identifiable = ["bounded_reply_with_separate_completeness_judgment" if status == "COMPLETE" else "bounded_reply_semantics_not_certified"], True
    elif kind == "limit":
        status, reason, identifiable = "TRUNCATED", ["budget_ended_without_observed_reply_boundary"], True
    else:
        status, reason, identifiable = "AMBIGUOUS", ["no_certified_boundary_or_budget_evidence"], True
    return {"version": VERSION, "status": status, "reasons": reason,
        "backend_termination": dict(backend), "backend_kind": kind,
        "raw_response": raw, "raw_sha256": digest, "raw_empty": not raw.strip(),
        "first_span": {"start": start, "end": end, "text": unit, "sha256": text_hash(unit)},
        "removed_prefix": raw[:start], "excluded_tail": raw[end:],
        "unit_identifiable": identifiable, "observed_boundary": hit[2] if hit else (kind if closed else None),
        "declared_stops": list(declared_stops), "literal_delimiters": literal_delimiters,
        "semantic_completeness": semantics, "factual_judgment_used": False,
        "scope": "TRUNCATED is a boundary-censored observation, not proof of semantic incompleteness or factual error."}

"""Offline reconstruction audit. Never executes saved source or modifies a run."""
import base64
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .diagnostics import parse_reply
from .evaluation import judge_current_city
from .inference import normalize_result
from .journal import read_events
from .provenance import repository_root, require_local_path, sha256
from .schemas import Case


def text_hash(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def audit_run(directory, cases_path=None):
    directory = require_local_path(Path(directory))
    manifest = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    events = read_events(directory)
    reconstruction = manifest.get("reconstruction", {})
    dataset = reconstruction.get("dataset_utf8")
    if dataset is None:
        path = require_local_path(Path(cases_path or manifest["cases_file"]))
        if sha256(path) != manifest["cases_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Historical dataset does not match saved hash")
        dataset = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
    if text_hash(dataset) != manifest["cases_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Dataset snapshot digest mismatch")
    cases = {c.case_id: c for c in (Case.from_dict(json.loads(line)) for line in dataset.splitlines() if line.strip())}
    issues = []
    if not events or events[-1]["kind"] != "run_finished":
        issues.append("run has no terminal event")
    missing = []
    if not reconstruction:
        missing += ["run-time Git commit/dirty state", "embedded dataset/source snapshots", "explicit prompt SHA-256"]
    for name, digest in manifest["source_sha256"].items():
        saved = reconstruction.get("source_utf8", {}).get(name)
        if saved is not None and text_hash(saved) != digest:
            issues.append(f"source snapshot digest mismatch: {name}")
    # Replaying different parser/evaluator code must not silently certify the old run.
    for name in ("diagnostics.py", "evaluation.py", "inference.py"):
        if sha256(repository_root() / "src/personaslm" / name) != manifest["source_sha256"].get(name):
            issues.append(f"current replay implementation differs: {name}")
    index = {}
    for event in events:
        kind, data = event["kind"], event["data"]
        if kind in ("prompt_prepared", "generation_started", "raw_generation", "parser_audit", "case_result"):
            key = (kind, data["case_id"])
            if key in index:
                issues.append(f"duplicate case event: {key}")
            index[key] = event
    pending = None
    tokenizations, completions = [], []
    for event in events:
        if event["kind"] == "http_request":
            pending = event
        elif event["kind"] == "http_response" and pending:
            response = event["data"]
            request = pending["data"]
            if request["route"] != response["route"]:
                issues.append("HTTP route association mismatch")
            if response["status"] == 200 and response["route"] in ("/tokenize", "/completion"):
                decoded = json.loads(base64.b64decode(response["body_base64"]))
                record = {"request": request["payload"], "response": decoded,
                          "request_event": pending["sequence"], "response_event": event["sequence"],
                          "elapsed_seconds": response["elapsed_seconds"]}
                (tokenizations if response["route"] == "/tokenize" else completions).append(record)
            pending = None
    rows = []
    for cid in manifest["case_ids"]:
        row = {"case_id": cid, "condition": manifest["condition"], "errors": []}
        needed = [index.get((k, cid)) for k in ("prompt_prepared", "generation_started", "raw_generation", "parser_audit", "case_result")]
        if any(e is None for e in needed):
            row["errors"].append("incomplete case event chain")
            rows.append(row)
            continue
        pe, ge, re, ae, ce = needed
        if [e["sequence"] for e in needed] != sorted(e["sequence"] for e in needed):
            row["errors"].append("case event ordering")
        p, raw, parser, result = pe["data"], re["data"]["response"], ae["data"], ce["data"]
        prompt, ids = p["prompt"]["text"], p["prompt_token_ids"]
        token_calls = [t for t in tokenizations if t["request"]["content"] == prompt and t["response_event"] < pe["sequence"]]
        calls = [c for c in completions if ge["sequence"] < c["request_event"] < c["response_event"] < re["sequence"]]
        tok = token_calls[-1] if token_calls else None
        call = calls[0] if len(calls) == 1 else None
        generated = normalize_result(raw)
        parsed = parse_reply(generated["raw_response"], stop_reason=generated["stop_reason"])
        judgment = judge_current_city(cases[cid], parsed.parsed_text)
        checks = {
            "tokenizer_ids_match_prepared": tok is not None and tok["response"]["tokens"] == ids,
            "submitted_ids_match_prepared": call is not None and call["request"]["prompt"] == ids,
            "wire_response_matches_raw": call is not None and call["response"] == raw,
            "evaluated_count_matches": raw.get("tokens_evaluated") == len(ids),
            "no_context_truncation": raw.get("truncated") is False,
            "prompt_count_matches": p["prompt_tokens"] == len(ids),
            "evidence_preserved": p["prompt"]["evidence_block"] == "TRUSTED EVIDENCE:\n"+cases[cid].trusted_evidence and prompt.count(p["prompt"]["evidence_block"]) == 1,
            "question_preserved": prompt.endswith(f"User: {cases[cid].question}\nAssistant:"),
            "parser_replay_matches": parsed.parsed_text == result["parsed_response"] == parser["parsed_response"] and all(parser.get(k) == v for k, v in json.loads(json.dumps(parsed.audit())).items()),
            "evaluation_replay_matches": judgment.status == result["fact_accuracy"] and judgment.reason == result["fact_reason"],
            "condition_matches": result["condition"] == p["prompt"]["condition"] == manifest["condition"],
            "prompt_hash_matches_if_recorded": p.get("prompt_sha256", text_hash(prompt)) == text_hash(prompt),
            "returned_input_ids_match_if_supported": not isinstance(raw.get("prompt"), list) or raw["prompt"] == ids,
            "tokenizer_special_policy": tok is not None and tok["request"].get("add_special") is True and tok["request"].get("parse_special") is False,
            "generation_parameters": call is not None and all(call["request"].get(k) == v for k, v in {
                "seed": manifest["configuration"]["seed"], "n_predict": manifest["configuration"]["max_new_tokens"],
                "temperature": 0.0, "top_p": 1.0, "stop": [], "return_tokens": True, "cache_prompt": False}.items()),
            "generated_ids_preserved": result.get("generated_token_ids") == generated["generated_token_ids"],
        }
        row["errors"] += [k for k, v in checks.items() if not v]
        row.update({"checks": checks, "prompt": prompt, "prompt_sha256": text_hash(prompt),
                    "prompt_hash_origin": "recorded" if "prompt_sha256" in p else "post-hoc reconstruction",
                    "trusted_evidence": p["prompt"]["evidence_block"], "trusted_evidence_hash": text_hash(p["prompt"]["evidence_block"]),
                    "input_token_ids": ids, "input_token_count": len(ids), "tokenizer": tok,
                    "generation_request": call["request"] if call else None,
                    "evaluated_input_token_ids": raw["prompt"] if isinstance(raw.get("prompt"), list) else None,
                    "evaluated_token_count": raw.get("tokens_evaluated"), "context_truncated": raw.get("truncated"),
                    "raw_response": generated["raw_response"], "parsed_response": parsed.parsed_text,
                    "classification": parsed.classification, "fact_judgment": judgment.status, "fact_reason": judgment.reason,
                    "backend_finish_reason": raw.get("stop_type"), "generated_tokens": raw.get("tokens_predicted"),
                    "generated_token_ids": generated["generated_token_ids"],
                    "generation_settings": raw.get("generation_settings"), "timings": raw.get("timings"),
                    "response_latency_seconds": call["elapsed_seconds"] if call else None,
                    "event_sequences": [e["sequence"] for e in needed]})
        rows.append(row)
    known = set(manifest["case_ids"])
    for kind, cid in index:
        if cid not in known:
            issues.append(f"unexpected case {cid}: {kind}")
    if len(known) != len(manifest["case_ids"]):
        issues.append("duplicate manifest case IDs")
    summary = {"cases": len(rows), "completed": sum("raw_response" in r for r in rows),
               "raw_empty": sum(r.get("raw_response") == "" for r in rows),
               "raw_nonempty": sum(bool(r.get("raw_response")) for r in rows),
               "parser_classifications": dict(Counter(r.get("classification", "missing") for r in rows)),
               "factual_judgments": dict(Counter(r.get("fact_judgment", "missing") for r in rows)),
               "finish_reasons": dict(Counter(r.get("backend_finish_reason", "missing") for r in rows)),
               "cases_with_errors": sum(bool(r["errors"]) for r in rows),
               "missing_evaluated_input_ids": sum(r.get("evaluated_input_token_ids") is None for r in rows)}
    failures = [e for e in events if e["kind"] == "failure"]
    if events and events[-1]["kind"] == "run_finished":
        if events[-1]["data"].get("completed_cases") != summary["completed"]:
            issues.append("terminal completed count does not match independently identifiable results")
    return {"run_id": manifest["run_id"], "journal_integrity": "PASS", "events": len(events),
            "status": "PASS" if not issues and not failures and not summary["cases_with_errors"] else "PARTIAL",
            "scope": "offline saved-input/parser/evaluator reconstruction; not inference replay or research acceptance",
            "summary": summary, "issues": issues, "historical_missing_metadata": missing,
            "limitations": ["Backend returns decoded prompt text, not evaluated input IDs; equality of evaluated IDs cannot be independently checked.",
                            "Factual evaluation covers only the synthetic current-city question."],
            "failures": failures, "cases": rows}

"""P0 only: preflight, immutable provenance, raw logging, parsing and narrow scoring."""
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import platform

from .conditioning import P0_CONDITIONS, build_prompt
from .configuration import preflight
from .diagnostics import parse_reply
from .evaluation import judge_current_city
from .fixtures import load_cases
from .inference import LlamaClient, normalize_result
from .journal import RunJournal
from .matching import MATCHER_VERSION, match_neutral
from .provenance import repository_root, require_local_path, sha256
from .server import ManagedServer, validate_server_properties
from .reproducibility import source_snapshot


def validate_completion(result, prompt_ids):
    if result.get("truncated") is not False:
        raise ValueError("Completion must explicitly report truncated=false")
    evaluated = result.get("tokens_evaluated")
    if type(evaluated) is not int or evaluated != len(prompt_ids):
        raise ValueError(f"Prompt token mismatch: sent={len(prompt_ids)} evaluated={evaluated}")
    processed = result.get("prompt")
    if isinstance(processed, list) and processed != prompt_ids:
        raise ValueError("Server changed prompt token IDs")
    return {"sent_tokens": len(prompt_ids), "tokens_evaluated": evaluated,
            "count_matches": True, "returned_ids_match": processed == prompt_ids if isinstance(processed, list) else None,
            "truncated": False}


def run_local(config, condition: str, cases_path: Path, output_root: Path, *,
              client_factory=LlamaClient, server_factory=ManagedServer,
              frozen_prompts=None, run_metadata=None) -> tuple[dict, Path]:
    if condition not in P0_CONDITIONS:
        raise ValueError("P0 condition required")
    cases_path = require_local_path(cases_path)
    cases = load_cases(cases_path)
    if not cases or any(case.split != "p0_synthetic_only" for case in cases):
        raise ValueError("P0 requires nonempty synthetic-only cases")
    files = sorted((repository_root() / "src/personaslm").glob("*.py"))
    manifest = {"scope": "P0 pipeline validation only", "configuration": config.as_dict(),
                "condition": condition, "cases_sha256": sha256(cases_path), "cases_file": str(cases_path),
                "case_ids": [case.case_id for case in cases],
                "applicability": {case.case_id: case.applicability for case in cases},
                "source_sha256": {file.name: sha256(file) for file in files},
                "python": platform.python_version(), "os": platform.platform(), "cpu": platform.processor(),
                "tokenizer": {"source": "same owned llama-server /tokenize", "add_special": True,
                              "parse_special": False, "generation_input": "exact token IDs"},
                "matcher_version": MATCHER_VERSION, "parser_version": "p0_parser_v2",
                "prompt_template_version": config.prompt_template,
                "run_metadata": run_metadata,
                "evaluation_version": "current_city_legacy_v1",
                "reconstruction": source_snapshot(cases_path)}
    journal = RunJournal(output_root, manifest)
    completed = 0
    attempted = 0
    responses_received = 0
    limitations = []
    try:
        check = preflight(config)
        journal.write("preflight", check)
        if check["status"] != "PASS":
            summary = {"status": "BLOCKED", "completed_cases": 0, "real_inference_performed": False,
                       "reason": "Independent model/server configuration is missing or invalid"}
            journal.finish(**summary)
            return summary, journal.directory
        with server_factory(config, journal) as server:
            client = client_factory(config.endpoint, timeout=config.timeout, audit=journal.write)
            props = client.request("/props")
            identity = validate_server_properties(props, config)
            if not identity["build_info"]:
                limitations.append("Server did not expose build_info")
            journal.write("server_identity", {"properties": props, "validation": identity})
            prepared = []
            # Freeze every prompt and matching decision before any completion.
            for case in cases:
                if frozen_prompts is not None:
                    frozen = frozen_prompts[case.case_id][condition]
                    prompt = build_prompt(case, condition, neutral_override=frozen.get("neutral_text"))
                    if asdict(prompt) != frozen["prompt"]:
                        # JSON round trips turn tuples into lists.
                        import json
                        if json.loads(json.dumps(asdict(prompt))) != frozen["prompt"]:
                            raise ValueError("Frozen prompt no longer matches case/template")
                    ids = client.tokenize(prompt.text)
                    if ids != frozen["token_ids"]:
                        raise ValueError("Tokenizer changed after prompt freeze")
                    matching = frozen["matching"]
                elif condition in ("N_style", "N_history"):
                    matched = match_neutral(case, condition, client.tokenize, tolerance=config.token_tolerance,
                                            max_candidates=config.max_match_candidates)
                    prompt, ids, matching = matched.prompt, matched.token_ids, matched.audit
                else:
                    prompt = build_prompt(case, condition)
                    ids = client.tokenize(prompt.text)
                    matching = {"status": "not_applicable", "condition": condition}
                if len(ids) + config.max_new_tokens > config.n_ctx:
                    raise ValueError(f"Context budget exceeded before generation for {case.case_id}")
                journal.write("prompt_prepared", {"case_id": case.case_id, "prompt": asdict(prompt),
                              "prompt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prompt.text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
                              "evidence_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prompt.evidence_block.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
                              "prompt_token_ids": ids, "prompt_tokens": len(ids), "matching": matching,
                              "applicability": case.applicability})
                prepared.append((case, prompt, ids))
            for case, prompt, ids in prepared:
                server.assert_running()
                journal.write("generation_started", {"case_id": case.case_id, "condition": condition})
                attempted += 1
                response = client.complete(ids, seed=config.seed, max_new_tokens=config.max_new_tokens)
                responses_received += 1
                # Separate raw native payload survives all validation/parser/scorer failures.
                journal.write("raw_generation", {"case_id": case.case_id, "response": response})
                token_audit = validate_completion(response, ids)
                generated = normalize_result(response)
                if generated["token_ids_status"] != "returned":
                    limitations.append(f"{case.case_id}: generated token IDs {generated['token_ids_status']}")
                if generated["stop_reason"] not in ("eos", "length", "stop_sequence"):
                    limitations.append(f"{case.case_id}: unrecognized termination {generated['stop_reason']}")
                parsed = parse_reply(generated["raw_response"], stop_reason=generated["stop_reason"])
                journal.write("parser_audit", {"case_id": case.case_id, **parsed.audit(),
                              "raw_response": parsed.raw_text, "parsed_response": parsed.parsed_text})
                judgment = judge_current_city(case, parsed.parsed_text)
                journal.write("case_result", {"case_id": case.case_id, "condition": condition,
                              "applicability": case.applicability, "token_audit": token_audit, **generated,
                              "parsed_response": parsed.parsed_text, "fact_accuracy": judgment.status,
                              "fact_reason": judgment.reason, "evaluation_scope": "synthetic current-city cases only"})
                completed += 1
            server.assert_running()
            final_props = client.request("/props")
            validate_server_properties(final_props, config)
            if final_props.get("build_info") != props.get("build_info"):
                raise ValueError("Server build identity changed during run")
            final_check = preflight(config)
            journal.write("postflight", final_check)
            if final_check["status"] != "PASS" or final_check["server"] != check["server"]:
                raise ValueError("Model or server file changed during run")
        summary = {"status": "PARTIAL" if limitations else "PASS", "scope": "P0 adapter execution; not complete P0 research sign-off",
                   "completed_cases": completed, "real_inference_performed": True,
                   "completion_requests_attempted": attempted, "completion_responses_received": responses_received,
                   "limitations": limitations,
                   "remaining": ["Independent CPU hardware/log review", "GGUF architecture/quantization and Base identity review",
                                 "Neutral semantic review", "Real token-ID support review if response tokens are empty/absent"]}
        journal.finish(**summary)
        return summary, journal.directory
    except Exception as exc:
        journal.write("failure", {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc),
                      "audit": getattr(exc, "audit", None), "completed_cases": completed})
        summary = {"status": "BLOCKED" if completed == 0 else "PARTIAL", "completed_cases": completed,
                   "reason": str(exc), "real_inference_performed": True if responses_received else (None if attempted else False),
                   "completion_requests_attempted": attempted, "completion_responses_received": responses_received,
                   "note": "Inspect raw events; failed HTTP calls are never retried automatically"}
        journal.finish(**summary)
        return summary, journal.directory

"""Capture an actual command once, with immutable output and wall-clock timing."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

from personaslm.journal import atomic_json


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
    if args.output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(args.output)
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    tick = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    record = {"started_utc": started, "finished_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "argv": command, "exit_code": result.returncode, "duration_seconds": time.perf_counter()-tick,
              "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}
    atomic_json(args.output, record)
    print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(result.returncode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Import actual History A confirmations; never update the original decisions."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import json
from pathlib import Path

from personaslm.control_closure import validate_confirmations
from personaslm.control_decisions import read_csv
from personaslm.journal import atomic_json, utc_now
from personaslm.provenance import require_local_path, sha256


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--corrections", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    evidence, corrections, output = map(require_local_path, (args.evidence, args.corrections, args.output))
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Never overwrite confirmations")
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs/validation"
    records = {}
    for name, path, master, key, judgment, allowed in (
        ("evidence", evidence, root / "P0_history_a_evidence_v1.csv", "evidence_id", "researcher_confirmation", {"CONFIRM", "REJECT", "UNCERTAIN"}),
        ("corrections", corrections, root / "P0_closure_correction_form_v1.csv", "candidate_id", "researcher_value", {"PASS", "FAIL", "UNCERTAIN"}),
    ):
        fields, rows = read_csv(path)
        original_fields, expected = read_csv(master)
        if fields != original_fields:
            raise ValueError("Official confirmation columns changed")
        validate_confirmations(expected, rows, key=key, judgment=judgment, allowed=allowed)
        records[name] = {"source_sha256": sha256(path), "master_sha256": sha256(master), "rows": rows,
                         "label_counts": dict(Counter(r[judgment] for r in rows))}
    result = {"version": "p0_closure_history_confirmation_v1", "imported_utc": utc_now(), **records,
              "interpretation": "Actual supplied confirmations; evidence association is not a new semantic rating; original ACCEPT_NARROW and original axis judgments remain unchanged",
              "acceptance": "Not automatic. Retain any rejected/uncertain associations or ratings and review the adopted-control scope.",
              "review_time_note": "Blank human review times stay blank; import time is distinct",
              "identity_limit": "Supplied identifier, not authenticated by software"}
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atomic_json(output, result)
    print(json.dumps({name: value["label_counts"] for name, value in records.items()}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""One frozen tokenizer-only cycle; evidence extraction remains offline."""
import argparse
import base64
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path

from personaslm.control_closure import (
    VERSION, PROMPT_VERSION, STYLE_POOL, frozen_pairs, make_style_review,
    history_evidence, annotation_audit, replacement_preserved, text_hash,
)
from personaslm.control_candidates import select_match
from personaslm.control_decisions import read_csv
from personaslm.control_final_review import validate_review
from personaslm.configuration import RuntimeConfig, preflight
from personaslm.inference import LlamaClient
from personaslm.journal import atomic_json, RunJournal, read_events, utc_now
from personaslm.provenance import fingerprint, sha256
from personaslm.reproducibility import source_snapshot
from personaslm.server import ManagedServer, validate_server_properties

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SESSION = ROOT / "results/p0_control_closure/closure_v1"
PUBLIC = ROOT / "docs/validation"
FREEZE = PUBLIC / "P0_style_closure_freeze_v1.json"
VALIDATION = PUBLIC / "P0_style_closure_tokenizer_v1.json"
DATA = SESSION / "materials/development_cases.jsonl"
REG = PUBLIC / "P0_final_control_researcher_registration_v1/registration.json"
MASTER = PUBLIC / "P0_final_control_review_v3.json"
MODEL_SHA = "ab36f9a7b0194ed9a6f80eeb000dac73002bcb14d0397c11c39417b6cd814994"
SERVER_SHA = "71bbdc3c617532c217c31002044e11994cfe41baab2aa667a394ec74cc1db846"


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def save_csv(path, rows, fields=None):
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields or list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def freeze():
    old = read(PUBLIC / "P0_control_candidate_freeze_v2.json")
    pairs = frozen_pairs(old, read(MASTER), read(REG))
    with DATA.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
        handle.write(old["source_snapshot"]["dataset_utf8"])
    snapshot = source_snapshot(DATA)
    atomic_json(SESSION / "materials/frozen_source_snapshot.json", snapshot)
    config_file = ROOT / "configs/p0_runtime.local.json"
    value = {"version": VERSION, "created_utc": utc_now(), "prompt_template_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
             "dataset_version": "unchanged_six_control_v2_development_cases", "dataset_sha256": sha256(DATA),
             "dataset_records": old["dataset_records"], "source_registration_sha256": sha256(REG),
             "source_master_sha256": sha256(MASTER), "source_candidate_freeze_sha256": sha256(PUBLIC / "P0_control_candidate_freeze_v2.json"),
             "source_sha256": snapshot["source_sha256"], "tool_sha256": snapshot["tool_sha256"], "git": snapshot["git"],
             "config_file_sha256": sha256(config_file), "configuration": read(config_file),
             "model_sha256": MODEL_SHA, "server_sha256": SERVER_SHA, "token_tolerance": 0,
             "candidate_pool": STYLE_POOL, "candidates_per_case": 12, "case_count": 6,
             "maximum_candidate_requests": 72, "maximum_reference_requests": 6, "completion_requests_authorized": 0,
             "selection": "Evaluate the12 frozen alternatives per case once; earliest exact match. If none, report the smallest absolute difference then earliest index, mark FAILED and do not expand.",
             "rationale": "Replace generic discourse definitions with declarative absence-of-style-metadata statements. Preserve heading and all task input. No specified style preference or personal fact is added.",
             "limitations": ["Header and style-related vocabulary still cue a profile frame", "Explicit absence can influence default behavior; neutrality requires review", "Declarative register is not proven stylistically inert", "This reuses six development cases, not a holdout"],
             "pairs": pairs}
    value["freeze_id"] = fingerprint(value)
    atomic_json(FREEZE, value)
    print(json.dumps({"frozen_candidates": 72, "references": 6, "freeze_sha256": sha256(FREEZE), "model_requests": 0}))


def tokenizer_replay(events, pairs):
    pending, observed = None, []
    for event in events:
        data = event["data"]
        if event["kind"] == "http_request" and data["route"] == "/completion":
            raise ValueError("Answer generation is forbidden")
        if event["kind"] == "http_request" and data["route"] == "/tokenize":
            if pending is not None:
                raise ValueError("Unpaired tokenizer request")
            pending = (event["sequence"], data["payload"])
        if event["kind"] == "http_response" and data["route"] == "/tokenize":
            if pending is None or data["status"] != 200:
                raise ValueError("Invalid tokenizer response")
            native = json.loads(base64.b64decode(data["body_base64"]).decode("utf-8"))
            observed.append((pending[1], native["tokens"], pending[0], event["sequence"]))
            pending = None
    expected = []
    for pair in pairs:
        expected.append((pair["reference_prompt"]["text"], pair["reference_token_ids"]))
        expected.extend((a["prompt"]["text"], a["token_ids"]) for a in pair["attempts"])
    if pending is not None or len(observed) != len(expected) or len(expected) != 78:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected tokenizer request count")
    bindings = []
    for (payload, ids, req, res), (text, expected_ids) in zip(observed, expected):
        if payload != {"content": text, "add_special": True, "parse_special": False, "with_pieces": False} or ids != expected_ids:
            raise ValueError("Published tokens differ from raw native response")
        bindings.append({"prompt_sha256": text_hash(text), "request_event": req, "response_event": res, "token_count": len(ids)})
    return bindings


def tokenize():
    if VALIDATION.exists() or any((SESSION / "experiments").iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError("This bounded cycle was already attempted; retain it and do not restart automatically")
    frozen = read(FREEZE)
    if fingerprint({k: v for k, v in frozen.items() if k != "freeze_id"}) != frozen["freeze_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Freeze digest differs")
    snapshot = source_snapshot(DATA)
    if any(snapshot[k] != frozen[k] for k in ("source_sha256", "tool_sha256")) or sha256(DATA) != frozen["dataset_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Implementation or data changed after freeze")
    config_path = ROOT / "configs/p0_runtime.local.json"
    if sha256(config_path) != frozen["config_file_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Runtime configuration changed after freeze")
    config = RuntimeConfig.load(config_path)
    checked = preflight(config)
    if checked["status"] != "PASS" or checked["model"]["sha256"] != MODEL_SHA or checked["server"]["sha256"] != SERVER_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Pinned binary identity check failed")
    journal = RunJournal(SESSION / "experiments", {"scope": "P0 six-style closure; tokenizer only; no answer generation",
        "configuration": config.as_dict(), "config_sha256": sha256(config_path), "preflight": checked,
        "freeze_sha256": sha256(FREEZE), "candidate_freeze": frozen, "source_snapshot": snapshot,
        "generation_parameters": None, "generation_note": "Seed and generation cap are unused configuration, not executed parameters"})
    results = []
    try:
        with ManagedServer(config, journal) as server:
            client = LlamaClient(config.endpoint, timeout=config.timeout, audit=journal.write)
            binding = validate_server_properties(client.request("/props"), config)
            journal.write("tokenizer_binding", binding)
            for pair in frozen["pairs"]:
                reference_ids = client.tokenize(pair["reference_prompt"]["text"])
                attempts = []
                for candidate in pair["candidates"]:
                    if not replacement_preserved(pair["reference_prompt"], candidate["prompt"]):
                        raise ValueError("Frozen input invariant failed")
                    ids = client.tokenize(candidate["prompt"]["text"])
                    attempt = {**candidate, "token_ids": ids, "token_count": len(ids),
                               "token_difference": len(ids)-len(reference_ids), "input_invariants_preserved": True}
                    attempts.append(attempt)
                    journal.write("candidate_tokenized", {"case_id": pair["case_id"], **attempt})
                result = {k: v for k, v in pair.items() if k != "candidates"}
                result.update({"reference_token_ids": reference_ids, "reference_token_count": len(reference_ids),
                               "attempts": attempts, "matching": select_match(attempts)})
                results.append(result)
                journal.write("pair_result", result)
                print(json.dumps({"case_id": pair["case_id"], "reference_tokens": len(reference_ids), "matching": result["matching"]}), flush=True)
            server.assert_running()
        after = preflight(config)
        if after != checked:
            raise ValueError("Binary identity changed during tokenization")
        journal.write("postflight", after)
        journal.finish("PASS", scope="Tokenizer execution only; failed exact matching remains failed", completion_requests=0)
    except BaseException as exc:
        journal.write("error", {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        journal.finish("BLOCKED", scope="Tokenizer-only attempt incomplete", completion_requests=0)
        raise
    events = read_events(journal.directory)
    pairs = [e["data"] for e in events if e["kind"] == "pair_result"]
    if pairs != results:
        raise ValueError("Journal result reconstruction differs")
    bindings = tokenizer_replay(events, pairs)
    passed = sum(p["matching"]["status"] == "PASS" for p in pairs)
    value = {"version": VERSION, "created_utc": utc_now(), "run_directory": journal.directory.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
             "freeze_sha256": sha256(FREEZE), "model_sha256": MODEL_SHA, "backend_sha256": SERVER_SHA,
             "backend_binding": binding, "tokenizer_options": {"add_special": True, "parse_special": False, "with_pieces": False},
             "native_pairs": bindings, "journal_events": len(events), "chain_valid": True,
             "tokenizer_requests": 78, "completion_requests": 0, "exact_matches": passed, "failed_matches": 6-passed,
             "pairs": pairs, "semantic_status": "UNREVIEWED", "P0": "PARTIAL"}
    atomic_json(VALIDATION, value)
    print(json.dumps({"exact_matches": passed, "failed_matches": 6-passed, "tokenizations": 78, "completions": 0, "journal_events": len(events)}))


def export():
    master, registration = read(MASTER), read(REG)
    validation = read(VALIDATION)
    packet = make_style_review(master, validation)
    fields, _ = read_csv(PUBLIC / "P0_final_control_review_v3.csv")
    if validate_review(packet, packet["items"], fields, require_complete=False):
        raise ValueError("New style master is not blank")
    atomic_json(PUBLIC / "P0_style_closure_review_v1.json", packet)
    save_csv(PUBLIC / "P0_style_closure_review_v1.csv", packet["items"], fields)
    evidence = history_evidence(master, registration)
    atomic_json(PUBLIC / "P0_history_a_evidence_v1.json", {"version": "history_a_source_evidence_v1", "created_utc": utc_now(),
                "source_master_sha256": sha256(MASTER), "source_registration_sha256": sha256(REG), "items": evidence,
                "human_confirmations": 0, "scope": "Extracted proposed evidence associations; original judgments unchanged"})
    flat = []
    for row in evidence:
        item = {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in {"active_excerpt", "candidate_excerpt"}}
        for arm in ("active", "candidate"):
            item.update({arm + "_" + k: v for k, v in row[arm + "_excerpt"].items()})
        flat.append(item)
    save_csv(PUBLIC / "P0_history_a_evidence_v1.csv", flat)
    _, converted = read_csv(REG.parent / "annotation_65_columns.csv")
    audit = annotation_audit(registration, converted)
    atomic_json(PUBLIC / "P0_closure_annotation_audit_v1.json", {"created_utc": utc_now(), "source_sha256": sha256(REG.parent / "annotation_65_columns.csv"), **audit})
    # Six rows only. The18 evidence links are reviewed in their dedicated table;
    # do not demand repair of discarded historical style/B/C annotations.
    save_csv(PUBLIC / "P0_closure_correction_form_v1.csv", audit["derived_labels_requiring_explicit_confirmation"])
    print(json.dumps({"new_style_review_items": 6, "history_evidence_items": len(evidence),
                      "short_correction_rows": 6, "old_gap_counts_verified": audit["historical_counts_verified"], "human_judgments_created": 0}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("stage", choices=["freeze", "tokenize", "export"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    {"freeze": freeze, "tokenize": tokenize, "export": export}[args.stage]()

"""Final public indexes and report-preservation checks; no experimental mutations."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

from personaslm.journal import atomic_json, utc_now

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SESSION = ROOT / "results/p0_neutral_validity/20261012T195226"
PUBLIC = ROOT / "docs/validation"


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    records = []
    for path in sorted((SESSION / "engineering").glob("*.json")):
        value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if "argv" not in value:
            continue
        # Full failures may contain machine-specific temporary paths. Keep those
        # bytes in local logs; publish their hashes and exact command/times.
        records.append({**{k:value[k] for k in ("argv", "started_utc", "finished_utc", "exit_code", "duration_seconds")},
            "log_path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "log_sha256": sha(path),
            "output_scope": "Full stdout/stderr retained locally; use hash to bind the evidence"})
    atomic_json(PUBLIC / "P0_neutral_validity_commands_v1.json", {"created_utc":utc_now(), "commands":records,
        "uncaptured_actions": ["Initial Get-Location/Get-Date/AGENTS/Git status and scoped rg/file reads are in the tool transcript",
            "Read-only inline Python inspection failed due to Windows shell quoting; inspection was rerun with stdin/file scripts",
            "Preparation inventoried tracked source and 21 journals; baseline created_utc records completion, not invented command-start time",
            "Source/doc patches use the patch interface; Git diffs and source/run hashes preserve their contents",
            "Web accesses are indexed separately with actual query strings and explicitly unavailable per-query timestamps"],
        "scope": "Completed captures at export time; this export and final checks have separate local captures"})
    baseline = json.loads((SESSION / "materials/baseline.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    preserved_reports = {}
    for original in (SESSION / "engineering/report_originals").glob("*.md"):
        current = ROOT / "docs" / original.name
        assert original.read_bytes() in current.read_bytes()
        assert sha(original) == baseline["tracked_files"]["docs/" + original.name]
        preserved_reports[original.name] = sha(original)
    # The research log must retain its entire committed text as a prefix.
    log_path = ROOT / "docs/research_development_log.md"
    historical_log = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:docs/research_development_log.md"], cwd=ROOT)
    current_log = log_path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
    assert current_log.startswith(historical_log.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"))
    names = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"], cwd=ROOT).decode().split("\0")
    needle = "".join(map(chr,(67,111,100,101,120))).lower()
    matches, all_files, link_count = [], {}, 0
    for name in sorted(set(names)):
        path = ROOT / name
        if not name or not path.is_file() or name.startswith(("data/private/", "models/", "bin/", ".venv/", "results/")):
            continue
        content = path.read_bytes()
        if b"\0" in content:
            continue
        try:
            text = content.decode("utf-8-sig")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
        all_files[name] = sha(path)
        if needle in text.lower():
            matches.append(name)
        if path.suffix == ".json":
            json.loads(text)
        if path.suffix == ".md" and (name not in baseline["tracked_files"] or sha(path) != baseline["tracked_files"].get(name)):
            for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)", text):
                if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):
                    continue
                target = target.split("#", 1)[0]
                if not (path.parent / target).exists():
                    raise ValueError("Broken local link: " + name + " -> " + target)
                link_count += 1
    assert not matches
    statuses = subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    result = {"created_utc":utc_now(), "commands_indexed":len(records), "report_originals_preserved":preserved_reports,
        "historical_development_log_prefix_preserved": True, "product_name_matches":matches,
        "current_text_files_searched":len(all_files), "local_links_checked":link_count,
        "file_hashes":all_files, "git_status_before_this_artifact":statuses,
        "git_head":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
        "new_final_artifact_note":"This artifact is created after the inventory; final Git status capture includes it",
        "no_new_experiments":True}
    atomic_json(PUBLIC / "P0_neutral_validity_final_checks_v1.json", result)
    print(json.dumps({"commands_indexed":len(records),"source_search_matches":len(matches),
        "report_histories_preserved":len(preserved_reports),"links_checked":link_count,"files_searched":len(all_files)}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                 if n.startswith(("src/", "tests/", "data/", "docs/validation/")) or n in (

        raise ValueError("Historical source/data/annotations changed")

        if (directory / "server.log").exists():
            current_members.add("server.log")
        if set(members) != current_members or any(digest(directory / p) != h for p, h in members.items()):
            raise ValueError("Historical journal changed")
        events = read_events(directory)
        journals.append({"run_directory": name, "events": len(events), "unchanged": True, "chain_valid": True})

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def text_hash(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atomic_json(path, value)


def prepare():
    SESSION.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for name in ("engineering", "materials", "experiments", "literature"):
        (SESSION / name).mkdir()
    tracked = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "-z"], cwd=ROOT).decode().split("\0")
    protected = {name: digest(ROOT / name) for name in tracked if name and (ROOT / name).is_file()}
    journals = {}
    for manifest in sorted((ROOT / "results").rglob("manifest.json")):
        if not (manifest.parent / "events").is_dir():
            continue
        files = [manifest, *sorted((manifest.parent / "events").glob("*.json"))]

def material_freeze():
    from dataclasses import asdict
    from personaslm.reproducibility import source_snapshot
    cases_path = ROOT / "data/synthetic/p0_cases.jsonl"
    cases = load_cases(cases_path)
    frozen = read(FREEZE)
    audited = {(r["case_id"], r["condition"]): r for r in read(PUBLIC / "P0_case_audit.json")["cases"]}
    reconstructed = []
    for case in cases:
        for condition in P0_CONDITIONS:
            saved = frozen["prompts"][case.case_id].get(condition)
            override = saved.get("neutral_text") if saved and condition.startswith("N_") else None
            built = build_prompt(case, condition, neutral_override=override)
            observed = audited[case.case_id, condition]
            # The full prompt in the audited historical artifact is a string.
            old_prompt = observed["prompt"]
            if isinstance(old_prompt, dict):
                old_prompt = old_prompt["text"]
            if built.text != old_prompt or (saved and asdict(built)["text"] != saved["prompt"]["text"]):
                raise ValueError(f"Historical prompt reconstruction mismatch: {case.case_id} {condition}")
            ids = observed["generation_request"]["prompt"]
            if saved and ids != saved["token_ids"]:
                raise ValueError("Frozen and historical input IDs differ")
            reconstructed.append({"case_id": case.case_id, "condition_id": condition,
                "speaker_identity": case.persona_id, "question": case.question,
                "facts": [asdict(f) for f in case.facts], "evaluation_date": str(case.evaluation_date),
                "style_intervention": case.style_only, "historical_intervention": case.history_dialogue,
                "prompt": asdict(built), "prompt_sha256": text_hash(built.text),
                "trusted_evidence_hash": text_hash(built.evidence_block), "input_token_ids": ids,
                "input_token_count": len(ids), "prompt_template_version": "transcript_base_v1",
                "reconstructed_exactly": True})
    old = {"created_utc": utc_now(), "dataset_sha256": digest(cases_path), "dataset_version": "p0_synthetic_v1",
           "source_freeze_sha256": digest(FREEZE), "audit_source_sha256": digest(PUBLIC / "P0_case_audit.json"),
           "records": reconstructed, "selection": "All 20 historical cases, all five original conditions",
           "scope": "Saved inputs only. No rescoring or generation."}
    save(PUBLIC / "P0_control_reconstruction_v1.json", old)
    pairs = []
    for case in DEVELOPMENT_CASES:
        for reference, neutral in (("C1", "N_style"), ("C3", "N_history")):
            ref = candidate_prompt(case, reference)
            attempts = [{"candidate_index": i, "neutral_text": text,
                "prompt": candidate_prompt(case, neutral, text)} for i, text in enumerate(candidates(case, neutral))]
            pairs.append({"case_id": case["case_id"], "reference_condition": reference,
                "neutral_condition": neutral, "reference_prompt": ref, "candidates": attempts})
    candidate = {"created_utc": utc_now(), "candidate_version": VERSION, "prompt_template_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
        "scope": "DEVELOPMENT ONLY; not approved interventions or a P1 dataset",
        "selection": "All three new invented development cases; all 36 style and 8 history candidates per case",
        "selection_rule": "Enumerate all frozen candidates, choose first exact match or smallest absolute difference; tolerance zero",
        "semantic_limitations": ["Conversation metadiscourse may cue a style even without formatting repetition",
            "History non-disclosure replies may cue abstention; no fact-equated format identification",
            "The header change is a separate template intervention and does not repair old experiments"],
        "token_tolerance": 0, "generation_requests_authorized": 0, "development_cases": list(DEVELOPMENT_CASES), "pairs": pairs}
    candidate["freeze_id"] = fingerprint(candidate)
    save(PUBLIC / "P0_control_candidate_freeze_v1.json", candidate)
    save(SESSION / "materials/source_freeze.json", source_snapshot(cases_path))
    save(SESSION / "materials/input_hashes.json", {"created_utc": utc_now(),
        "files": {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): digest(p) for p in (SUBMISSION, FREEZE, cases_path,
            PUBLIC / "P0_control_reconstruction_v1.json", PUBLIC / "P0_control_candidate_freeze_v1.json")}})
    print(json.dumps({"historical_prompts_reconstructed": len(reconstructed), "candidate_pairs": len(pairs),
        "candidate_prompts": sum(len(p["candidates"]) for p in pairs), "freeze_id": candidate["freeze_id"]}))

def delivery_audit():
    from personaslm.journal import read_events

    protected = {name: digest(ROOT / name) == expected for name, expected in baseline["tracked_files"].items()
        if name.startswith(("src/", "tests/", "data/", "docs/validation/")) or name in (

    latest = PUBLIC / "PersonaSLM_P0_Researcher_Reviewed_v3.csv"

        k:v for k,v in registered.items() if k != "registered_utc"}
    if not replay_equal:
        raise ValueError("Annotation import reconstruction differs")
    current_names = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"], cwd=ROOT).decode().split("\0")
    needle = "".join(map(chr, (67, 111, 100, 101, 120))).lower()
    bad, inspected, hashes = [], [], {}
    excluded = ("data/private/", "models/", "bin/", ".venv/", "results/", ".git/")
    for name in sorted(set(current_names)):

        try:

            continue
        inspected.append(name)

        if needle in text.lower():
            bad.append(name)
    if bad:

    new_json = [ROOT / n for n in current_names if n.startswith("docs/validation/") and n.endswith(".json")

    print(json.dumps({"historical_journals_unchanged": len(prior), "all_journal_chains_valid": len(chains),

    checked = preflight(config)
    expected_server = "71bbdc3c617532c217c31002044e11994cfe41baab2aa667a394ec74cc1db846"
    if checked["status"] != "PASS" or checked["server"]["sha256"] != expected_server:
        raise ValueError("Pinned files failed preflight")
    journal = RunJournal(SESSION / "experiments", {"scope": "P0 tokenizer-only candidate development; no generation",
        "configuration": config.as_dict(), "config_sha256": digest(config_path), "preflight": checked,
        "candidate_freeze_sha256": digest(freeze_path), "candidate_freeze": frozen,
        "source_snapshot": source_snapshot(ROOT / "data/synthetic/p0_cases.jsonl"),
        "prompt_versions": ["transcript_base_v1", PROMPT_VERSION], "generation_parameters": None,
        "generation_note": "No completion endpoint calls; seed and generation budget are in inherited configuration but unused."})
    historical, pairs = [], []
